name: Marc Andreessen / Ben Horowitz

summary.text: Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz are the co-founders of the venture firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z, legally AH Capital Management). In 2023 the firm gave $19 million to the pro-crypto super PAC Fairshake, recorded in FEC filings under AH Capital Management and attributed to its founders, and in May 2024 it announced a further $25 million; a16z's Chris Dixon said the firm had by then given $47 million in campaign contributions. FactCheck.org in 2026 described Andreessen and Horowitz as two of the super PAC's biggest individual donors.

openQuestions: The site's Fairshake entry speaks of '$260M' raised; the a16z-specific total found is $44–47 million through mid-2024 ($19m + $25m, plus Dixon's $47m figure). Later contributions for the 2026 cycle were not quantified here; FEC filings for Fairshake (C00835959) should be checked.
The site treats the two founders as one entity; separate files exist for marc-andreessen and andreessen-horowitz.
